title: MMS Tripolar Hall-Field Event of 22 January 2016: Data and Analysis Software
description: Analysis software, derived numerical data, metadata, and figure-production materials supporting a study of a tripolar Hall electromagnetic structure observed by the Magnetospheric Multiscale mission during strong-guide-field reconnection at Earth's dayside magnetopause. The principal event interval is 07:18:44-07:18:53 UT on 22 January 2016. Original Level-2 MMS data remain available from NASA SPDF; exact filenames, versions, and direct source links are supplied in the repository metadata. Analysis code is licensed under the MIT License; derived data and documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0 as specified by the license files included in the archive.
